courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鐵路回流與雜散電流控制
related.transfer: 可遷移「牽引直流需求」與「集電點幾何餘量」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鐵路回流與雜散電流控制的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Traction DC current demand" and "Collector geometric overlap reserve" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Rail-return and stray-current control must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦第三軌壓降集電靴連續性與熱容量；鐵路回流與雜散電流控制則以回路電位分流與雜散電荷控制為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on third-rail voltage drop shoe continuity and thermal capacity; Rail-return and stray-current control centres on return potential current division and stray-charge control, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「牽引直流需求」與「鋼軌回流壓降」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鐵路回流與雜散電流控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「收集回路比例」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Traction DC current demand” and “Rail-return voltage drop”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Rail-return and stray-current control, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Collection-circuit current fraction", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦第三軌壓降集電靴連續性與熱容量；預鑄軌道板精調則以多點測量調整閉合與誤差傳播為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on third-rail voltage drop shoe continuity and thermal capacity; Precision alignment of precast track slabs centres on multi-point survey adjustment closure and uncertainty propagation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「牽引直流需求」與「平移偏差合成」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到預鑄軌道板精調，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「水準閉合分配」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Traction DC current demand” and “Translation-error magnitude”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Precision alignment of precast track slabs, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Levelling closure allocation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 直流第三軌供電設計
history.text: 本課把直流第三軌供電設計放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。第三軌供電將接觸幾何與低電壓大電流回路連在一起，供電中斷區、集電靴配置和回流路徑共同影響列車供能。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places DC third-rail power-supply design in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Third-rail supply links contact geometry with a low-voltage high-current circuit; gaps, shoe arrangement and return paths jointly affect train power. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「牽引直流需求」到「絕緣漏流量級」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Traction DC current demand" through "Insulation leakage scale" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
